name: inspira-tracing-beam
title: Tracing Beam Effect
blurb: Glowing line traces down content on scroll, marking progress through a page.
description: Wraps content and renders a winding SVG line with a spring-animated gradient beam that follows scroll position down the page.
use_when: Long-form documentation, timelines, or story-driven pages where visual progress tracking enhances navigation and…
avoid_when: Short single-viewport pages — the effect requires scrollable height to be meaningful.
a11y: SVG is marked `aria-hidden`; focus and keyboard navigation work on child content. Visual progress tracking only.
